EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ah, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}hello there!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} I just delivered
some mail to you!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ah, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}salut !{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Je viens justement de
déposer du courrier pour toi !
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Aa, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}merhaba!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Sana az önce
birkaç mektup teslim ettim!

EN:
I already put it in your {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}mailbox{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}so be sure to check it later.
ES:
Lo he metido en tu {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}buzón{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}así que
no te olvides de abrirlo.
FR:
Alors pense à regarder dans ta
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}boîte aux lettres{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}d'accord ?
IT:
L'ho già messa nella tua {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cassetta
delle lettere{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Non dimenticare
di ritirarla!
TRANSLATION:
Hepsini {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}posta kutuna{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} koydum,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}sonra kontrol etmeyi unutma.

EN:
When your mailbox is full, I can't
cram any more in there, so{{TAG:0003:0001:}} don't
forget to collect your mail, OK?
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}When you have mail,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} you'll see a
blinking sign like you see now.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
That's how you'll know!
Well, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}I've gotta get moving!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}I'll see you later!
ES:
Cuando tu buzón esté lleno, no
podré entregarte más cartas.{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
Recuerda vaciarlo de vez en cuando.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Podrás ver un sobre parpadeando
en el buzón cuando tengas correo.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}En fin,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} te dejo, que tengo que seguir
con el reparto.{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}} ¡Nos vemos!
FR:
Si ta boîte aux lettres est pleine, je
peux plus rien y mettre, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}alors pense
à la vider de temps en temps, OK ?
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Quand tu as du courrier, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}un petit
drapeau clignotant t'en avertit,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
comme maintenant. {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Pas bête, hein ?
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Bon, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}hou là là, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}j'ai encore du pain
sur la planche !{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0020:}}Je file,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} à plus !
IT:
Quando la tua cassetta delle lettere
è piena, non posso più consegnarti
nulla, {{TAG:0003:0001:}}quindi svuotala regolarmente!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Quando ricevi della posta,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} vedrai
il segnale lampeggiare come adesso.
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Niente male, eh?!
Così capirai che c'è posta per te!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Beh, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}mi rimetto al lavoro!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Ci vediamo!
DE:
Wenn dein Briefkasten voll ist, kann
ich dir keine Briefe zustellen, {{TAG:0003:0001:}}also
leere ihn regelmäßig aus!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Dass du Post hast, erkennst du an
diesem kleinen, blinkenden Symbol
an deinem Briefkasten!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Also gut, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}ich muss weiter!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Wir sehen uns!
TRANSLATION:
Posta kutun dolunca içine daha fazla
mektup sığdıramıyorum, o yüzden{{TAG:0003:0001:}} postalarını
toplamayı unutma, tamam mı?
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Postan olduğunda,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} şimdi gördüğün gibi
yanıp sönen bir işaret görürsün.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Böylece anlarsın!
Pekâlâ, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}ben yola koyulayım!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Sonra görüşürüz!

EN:
When your mailbox is full, I can't
make any more deliveries, so be
sure to take out the letters, OK?
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}See? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}You can tell your mailbox is
completely full at the moment, so{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
please empty it as soon as possible!
Well, that's all for now. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}I've gotta
get moving!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0020:}}See ya later!
ES:
Cuando tu buzón se llene, no habrá
forma de meter más cartas en él.
Acuérdate de vaciarlo regularmente.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Fíjate, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}tu buzón está abarrotado de
cartas.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} ¡Vacíalo cuanto antes, por
favor!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Bueno, de momento no tengo nada
más que contarte. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Sigo con el
reparto, que tengo faena.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0020:}}¡Adiós!
FR:
Si ta boîte aux lettres est pleine, je
peux plus rien y mettre, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}alors pense
à la vider de temps en temps, OK ?
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ben justement, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}c'est le cas en ce
moment, alors fais-moi plaisir{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} et
vide-la le plus vite possible !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Bon, c'est pas tout ça, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}mais j'ai une
tournée à terminer, moi. {{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Allez, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}au
plaisir !
IT:
Quando la tua cassetta delle lettere
è piena, non posso più consegnarti
nulla. Ricordati di svuotarla, OK?
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Vedi, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}come adesso per esempio.
Hai la cassetta piena!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Cerca
di svuotarla il prima possibile!
Beh, ora è meglio che vada.
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Mi rimetto al lavoro!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0020:}}Ci vediamo!
DE:
Wenn dein Briefkasten voll ist, kann
ich dir keine Post mehr zustellen,
also nimm deine Briefe immer raus!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Im Moment ist dein Briefkasten zum
Beispiel randvoll.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Leere ihn bitte so
schnell wie möglich aus!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Also dann, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}ich muss weiter!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Bis später!
TRANSLATION:
Posta kutun doluyken başka teslimat
yapamıyorum; mektupları çıkarmayı
unutma, tamam mı?
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Bak! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Şu anda posta kutunun tamamen
dolu olduğu belli, o yüzden{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
mümkün olduğunca çabuk boşalt lütfen!
Şimdilik bu kadar. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Ben yola koyulayım!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Sonra görüşürüz!

EN:
When you want to send a letter,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} just
visit the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}post office {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}over in the
shopping district.
I'm just the delivery guy,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} so I can't
take any of your mail directly. It's
just how the rules work, I guess.
ES:
Si quieres enviar una carta, pásate
por la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}oficina de correos {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}de la zona
comercial.
Yo solo soy el cartero,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} no puedo
coger tu correo así como así, que
no tengo matasellos ni nada.
Las normas son las normas.
FR:
Si tu veux envoyer une lettre,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
rends-toi au {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}bureau de {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}poste{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}} {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}situé
dans la rue commerçante.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Moi, je fais que distribuer,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} j'ai pas
de tampon et tout ça, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}alors je peux
pas prendre tes lettres directement.
IT:
Quando vuoi mandare una lettera,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
devi andare all'{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}ufficio postale
{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}in Via degli Acquisti.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Io sono {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Tino{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} il postino{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} e mi occupo
soltanto delle consegne.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Purtroppo, se hai della posta da
spedire, non la posso prendere io.
Mi dispiace, ma sono le regole!
DE:
Wenn du einen Brief verschicken
willst,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} gehe einfach zum {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Postamt
{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}drüben auf der Einkaufsmeile.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Ich bin nur der Postbote, also kann
ich Briefe nicht direkt mitnehmen.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
So sind nun mal die Regeln.
TRANSLATION:
Mektup göndermek istediğinde,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} alışveriş
bölgesindeki {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}postaneye {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}uğraman yeterli.
Ben sadece dağıtım yapıyorum,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} o yüzden
mektuplarını doğrudan alamıyorum.
Kurallar böyle işte.

EN:
You can buy {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}stationery{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} for writing
letters from the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}shop{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} in the
shopping district!
If people don't write letters, we'll
go out of business{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}So I hope you write lots of letters!
IT:
Puoi comprare la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}carta da lettere
{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}al {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}negozio{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} in Via degli Acquisti!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Se la gente smettesse di scrivere
lettere, noi dell'ufficio postale{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
resteremmo disoccupati!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Datti da fare, mi raccomando!
DE:
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Briefpapier {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}kannst du im {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Laden{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} auf
der Einkaufsmeile kaufen!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Wenn keiner mehr Briefe schreibt,
verliere ich meinen Job{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich hoffe,
du schreibst jede Menge Briefe!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}By the way, letters aren't just for
sending messages. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}You can use them
to send presents too.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}It doesn't cost you a thing,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} so I'd be
quite happy to send something along
if you ever need it done!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Además de mensajes, en tus cartas
puedes incluir regalos.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Es un servicio totalmente gratuito,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}así que aprovéchalo y haz muy feliz
al destinatario de tu carta.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Au fait, tu sais que tu peux joindre
des cadeaux à tes lettres ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}C'est gratuit,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} alors te prive pas !{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Mais évite les trucs trop lourds,
hein, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}pense à mon dos !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Ad ogni modo, le lettere non sono
fatte solo per mandare messaggi.
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Puoi usarle anche per inviare regali!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il servizio non costa nulla! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Se devi
spedire qualcosa a qualcuno, conta
pure su di noi!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Briefe sind übrigens nicht nur für
Nachrichten gut. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Du kannst auch
Geschenke mit ihnen verschicken.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Und das kostet dich keinen Sterni!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Wenn du also was zu verschicken
hast, stelle ich es gerne zu!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Bu arada, mektuplar yalnızca mesaj
göndermek için değildir. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Onlarla
hediye de gönderebilirsin.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Üstelik sana hiçbir maliyeti yok,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} o yüzden
göndermek istediğin bir şey olursa memnuniyetle
yerine ulaştırırım!
